run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the CLI script to preprocess relaxed trajectory files into LMDB graph feature databases for S2EF
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run the write_images_to_lmdb function to convert ASE trajectory samples into pickled graph objects stored in LMDB
run_main_preprocess: run the main function to chunk trajectory files across workers and extract graph features into LMDB databases
review_atoms_to_graphs_config: review the AtomsToGraphs initialization with max_neigh 50, radius 6, and edges enabled for feature extraction
refactor_preprocess_relaxed_splits: refactor the preprocess_relaxed script to support custom split names beyond id, ood_ads, ood_cat, and ood_both
